guidance_ledger.note: EMPTY, and that is a finding rather than an omission. Sinai Cement publishes no forward guidance, no results presentation and no earnings call in any of its six filings or on its own website — the prior study's sweep logged that as a negative search and this run confirms it. So the guidance-is-scored-never-consumed clause has nothing to score here, and no driver in this model can have inherited a management lean, because there is no management forward number to inherit.
